sin.name: enum-value-match
sin.description: A `match`/`switch` over an enum's `->value` at the call site — logic that belongs on the enum but lives elsewhere instead.
sin.rule: Put per-case behaviour on the enum; never `match`/`switch` over its `->value` at a call site.
sin.suggestion: A method on the backed enum (`$x->label()`, `$x->isPaid()`).
